commits_data.message:
Bluetooth: Improve Android Vendor Dissectors OCF 0x153 0x157 0x159

* LE Get Vendor Capabilities (OCF 0x0153)
* LE APCF commands (OCF 0x0157)
* Fix LE Get Controller Activity Energy Info dissection (OCF 0x0159)

Bluetooth: Improve LE Get Vendor Capabilities dissection

Dissect the LE Get Vendor Capabilities (OCF 0x0153) response in full,
including the capabilities added in Google feature spec v1.05 and v1.06,
and make the version field human readable.
- Split version_supported into separate major and minor octets and show
  the parent field as V<major>.<minor> through a custom formatter.
- Parse iso_link_feedback_support and sniff_offload_support for spec
  version 1.05 and higher.
- Parse big_set_channel_map_classification_support,
  vendor_connection_handle_min/max and connection_proximity_threshold
  for spec version 1.06 and higher.
- Add the Opus bit to the A2DP source offload and dynamic audio buffer
  capability masks and update their reserved masks accordingly.
- Order the capability bitmask entries from bit 0 upwards.
- Give the deprecated reserved capability fields descriptive names.

Assisted-by: ZCode
Signed-off-by: fanshixia <fs000x@gmail.com>

Bluetooth: Dissect Android LE APCF commands

Add dissection of the LE Advertising Packet Content Filter (APCF)
vendor commands and their command complete events, and use the
documented opcode names.

Command side:
- Rename the 0x0157 opcode and its subcode field to the documented
  names.
- Parse each APCF subcommand: Enable, Set Filtering Parameters,
  Broadcaster Address, Service UUID, Service Solicitation UUID,
  Local Name, Manufacturer Data, Service Data, Transport Discovery
  Service, AD Type Filter and Read Extended Features.
- Decode the feature selection and list logic bitmasks, filter logic
  type, RSSI thresholds, delivery mode and tracking parameters.
- Split the data/mask subcommands into equal length data and mask
  halves, and decode the AD Type filter data and mask.
- Fix the previous parsing, which unconditionally read an action and
  filter index even for the Enable subcommand.

Command complete side:
- Decode the echoed action and available spaces, the enable state and
  the Read Extended Features bitmask.
- Show the subcommand name with its details in the Info column, and
  skip the generic opcode name for APCF so it is not duplicated.

Assisted-by: ZCode:deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp
Signed-off-by: fanshixia <fs000x@gmail.com>

Bluetooth: Fix LE Get Controller Activity Energy Info dissection

The LE Get Controller Activity Energy Info (OCF 0x0159) response carries
four 4-octet parameters, not four 1-octet ones, and they are little-endian.
- Read total_tx_time_ms, total_rx_time_ms, total_idle_time_ms and
  total_energy_used as 4-octet little-endian values in the documented
  order.
- Use the full "LE Get Controller Activity Energy Info" command name and
  document the unit of total_energy_used.

Signed-off-by: fanshixia <fs000x@gmail.com>
